lines.zh: 我一步一步从水里上来
lines.en: I rise out of the water, step by step.
My crown is still wet.
My soaked robe is heavy.
I walk along the waterline.
Every step leaves water behind.
My subjects are long gone.
I walk toward higher ground.
My boots are full of water.
I walk slowly, but I do not stop.
Weeds tangle in my cloak.
I stand, water dripping from my hem.
My crown has slipped a little.
I listen to distant waves.
This place is far too dry.

lines.zh: 我抬起手,看了看指间的水
lines.en: I raise a hand and look at the water in it.
I slowly straighten my back.
The tide sounds inside me.
My breath carries salt.
Water drips from my crown, one by one.
My throne is not here.
I settle my cloak.
I am very tired indeed.
I raise my head toward the distance.
The water reflects me.

lines.zh: 我想起一场没打完的仗
lines.en: I recall a battle never finished.

lines.zh: 安静得不太像我的宫殿
lines.en: This quiet is not my palace's.
You stand on my tide line.
I lift my eyes to you.
Your breath fogs the water.

lines.zh: 你的热气，让我的袍子发潮。
lines.en: Your warmth dampens my robe.

lines.zh: 我的王冠值得你看这么久吗
lines.en: Is my crown worth so long a look?
Step back, and the water steps back.
I do not recognise you.
But I remember how to look at one.
I lean forward slowly.
My robe is dripping.
The water at your feet is rising.
This is my domain.
I step back, and water splashes.
Another tear in my robe.
My crown slipped.
I steady myself by the shoulder.
This body has soaked too long.
I made no sound at all.
Another colour mixes into the water.
My crown slips a little.
You have broken my courtesy.
My hem tears; seawater leaks out.
What have you brought?

lines.zh: 我已经很久没有收到供奉
lines.en: I have not received an offering in ages.
I hold my hand out.
This is not to my taste.
Nevertheless I accept it.

lines.zh: 我的臣民也曾这样献上东西
lines.en: My subjects once offered things like this.
I close my hand around it.
Water runs between my fingers.
You know the forms, at least.
Set it a little nearer.

lines.zh: 你撞在我身上,湿了一片
lines.en: You hit me; you are soaked.
I did not move a step.
My robe is stiffer than it looks.
The water pushed you back.
That was not yet an insult.
I turn around slowly.
You stepped on my cloak.
Water spills from my sleeve.
Back off from my tide line.

lines.zh: 袖口的水，溅了你一裤脚。
lines.en: Water from my sleeve splashes your boots.
This place has been empty a long time.

lines.zh: 我把王冠摘下来一会儿
lines.en: I take my crown off for a while.
The water covers many words.
Will you stand beside me?
This stretch of sea is ours.
I have not stood shoulder to shoulder in ages.
Neither of us needs to speak.
The tide will always come.
Do not fear the water on me.
Just stand shoulder to shoulder.
I stoop to take it.
The water has softened its shape.
I squeeze it with my hand.
This is no offering.
But it is mine now.
Water still drips from my crown.
A heavy piece.
It carries someone else's scent.
I tuck it into my robe.
It would suit the side of a throne.
You have disturbed my water.
I raise my head; my crown sits straight.
You have stepped into my domain.

lines.zh: 我的披风吸饱了水，很沉。
lines.en: My cloak is heavy with water.
The tide is moving toward you.

lines.zh: 我很久没有这样的兴致了
lines.en: I have not felt such interest in ages.
Your breathing is hurried.
The surface is no longer level.
I have seen how you stand.
This fight, I accept.
No need for formalities.
Retreat, and the water follows.
My subjects will be watching.
Then let us begin in form.
Show me what the living are like.

lines.zh: 你还有一次机会，溺亡的王冠还在滴水。
lines.en: One chance left; my drowned crown still drips.
This water is mine.
And so is this water.
I rise, and the water sinks away.
Do not let your eyes leave the water.

lines.zh: 溺亡的王者，王冠还湿着。
lines.en: A drowned king, and the crown is still wet.
The water arrives before I do.

lines.zh: 你走到哪,水面就跟到哪
lines.en: The water follows wherever you go.

lines.zh: 我在等你脚下的地变软
lines.en: I wait for the ground to soften.

lines.zh: 潮水跟着我的脚，往上爬。
lines.en: The tide climbs behind my steps.
You have backed to the water.
One more step and you are mine.
I close in bit by bit.
The tide climbs inch by inch.
You are standing in water.
I have taken a long time to reach this step.

lines.zh: 我抬起手,水跟着抬起来
lines.en: I raise a hand, and the water rises with it.
Listen; the water is sounding.
That tide-sound comes from me.
Only one step remains.
I am in no hurry for it.
Because you have little time left.
The tide will count for me.
Within this single step.
Now it belongs to me.
My hand comes down.
Water crashes down with it.
You are swept off your feet.
My crown sways on my head.
My robe is torn open.
I step back, and the water surges in.
You are soaked through.
The surge makes your footing slip.
My swollen crown still fits.
My throne waits for my return.
You have fallen into the water.
The water will remember this.
I stand and look down at you.
Do you mean to rise?
The water rises first.

lines.zh: 水退下去，王冠先露出来。
lines.en: The water falls back; my crown surfaces first.
My crown breaks the surface.
Wet robe clings to me.
Water begins to seep through this ground.
The sound of ebbing tide comes from far off.
I lift my face.
Weeds hang on my shoulder.
I set down my first step.
The puddle at my feet spreads.
I have not come ashore in a long while.
Where are my subjects?
No one answers me.
Then I will do it myself.
The tides of this world are too shallow.

lines.zh: 它该涨到我该在的位置
lines.en: They should rise to where I belong.
I am standing upright.
The crown sits straight.
I have brought the water.
You may all step aside.
The water grows scalding.
I fall into the shallows.

lines.zh: 我泡在水里,却开始下沉
lines.en: Soaked in water, yet I begin to sink.
The water bursts and I lose my footing.
An arrow pins my robe.

lines.zh: 那道力量推开我身边的水
lines.en: That force pushes the water from me.
So long, and nothing eaten.

lines.zh: 雷打进水里,我全身一震
lines.en: Lightning hits the water and jolts me.
There is not even a tide here.
